state_analysis: The analysis_report.txt file has been created. Now I need to create the optimized_logrotate.conf and rotation_summary.csv files.
explanation: Create the optimized logrotate configuration file with proper rotation schedules, compression, and retention policies for all log files.

commands.keystrokes:
cat > /app/optimized_logrotate.conf << 'EOF'
# Optimized Logrotate Configuration
# Generated by Log Rotation Analyzer
# Addresses: disk space issues, inconsistent rotation, missing compression
#
# Key optimizations:
# - Daily rotation for high-growth logs
# - Compression enabled on all logs
# - Retention periods aligned with compliance requirements
# - Size-based triggers for runaway growth protection

# Application Log - High importance, 15.2 MB/day growth
# Changed from weekly to daily rotation
/var/log/samples/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 30
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    postrotate
        # Reload application if needed
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload web-server 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# System Log - Critical importance, 90-day retention required
# Increased rotation count for compliance
/var/log/samples/system.log {
    daily
    rotate 90
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root adm
    maxsize 20M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl kill -s HUP rsyslog 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Access Log - Medium importance, 45.7 MB/day growth (highest)
# Changed from monthly to daily - critical for disk space
/var/log/samples/access.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 100M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload nginx 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Error Log - Critical importance, NO previous rotation config!
# New configuration - 60-day retention for compliance
/var/log/samples/error.log {
    daily
    rotate 60
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload web-server 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Debug Log - Low importance, NO previous rotation config!
# New configuration - aggressive rotation, short retention
/var/log/samples/debug.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 25M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    # Debug logs can be truncated if empty for extended period
    ifempty
}
EOF
